Direct pseudoinverse gives r(z)=(2/N)sum_{chi nontriv}(1-chi(z))/lambda_chi. The unnormalized Walsh transform of r² on nontrivial tau equals (4/N)(sum_chi a_chi a_(chi tau)-2A a_tau). Generatorwise sign subadditivity lambda_tau<=lambda_chi+lambda_(chi tau) implies sum_chi a_chi a_(chi tau)<=2A a_tau-2a_tau², hence B=-H R² H/2 has eigenvalues b_tau>=4/(N lambda_tau²)>0. Equality is attained exactly when tau(s)=-1 for every generator, characterizing the unique connected bipartition Walsh mode. Positive definite centered Gram rank N-1 implies R itself is an affine-independent Euclidean distance metric; continuity in p yields some strict negative type above 2. Independent exact rational grounded-Laplacian/Walsh checks on small weighted Boolean groups confirm sign and equality but do not prove general dimension/real weights.
